title: Number of Days Between Two Dates
summary: Develop a program to calculate the number of days between two dates provided as YYYY-MM-DD strings.
statement: Develop a program to calculate the number of days between two dates provided as YYYY-MM-DD strings.
constraints: Dates are valid ISO YYYY-MM-DD from 1971 through 2100.
Return the nonnegative absolute day difference.
hints: Convert each date to a serial day count from a fixed epoch.
Add complete years with leap days, complete months using the current year’s February length, and the day.
Return the absolute difference of the two serial values.
Equal epoch offsets cancel, leaving exactly the number of crossed midnights.
editorial: Equal epoch offsets cancel, leaving exactly the number of crossed midnights.

tests.explanation: The dates are one day apart.
Crossing the year boundary gives fifteen days.
